brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy (a tidy organiser with separate places for supplies)
requirements.evidence: One Hex base (piece:0,0,0 full) holding a full-depth 3-compartment bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3), giving three separate compartments for supplies. Six solid end caps close the open faces. check_build is ok with meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: House rules: close open faces and lock joints
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces applied (6 solid caps). lockJoints returned NO_CHANGE, since a single base has no joints to bolt, so nothing was locked.

finish.summary: I built a small sewing organiser: one hex base with a three-compartment full-depth tray, with the open faces capped. The configurator checks pass with no clashes. I did not add props, since the catalogue has no sewing items and the tools on offer (screwdrivers, hex keys and so on) would not match the purpose. The organiser is one cell, so it holds three kinds of supply; if you need more room, more bases can be added later. Material and print suitability were not checked.
